_about: Every voice-over line in Aqua Energizer. make_voices.bat reads this file. 'set' is base (already recorded) or story (the story script). Words in [brackets] are ElevenLabs audio tags: they set the delivery and are not spoken. Script by character: docs/voice-script.md.

audition.narrator: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls. [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
audition.diver: [determined] Then he’ll see us coming. With our lights on. [laughs] Boing, boing, whoa-ho-ho!
audition.pip: [excited, breathless] Whoa, whoa, WHOA! Somebody just woke a gate! [nervous] I’m not scared. My fins are just cold.
audition.shelly: [slow, gravelly] Red eyes, you say? Hmph. Then my old bones were right. [fierce] And I have two hundred years of anger.
audition.clack: [booming, pompous] HALT! Who goes there? [proudly] Captain Clack, at your service! Nobody pinches pearls on MY reef!
audition.mira: [serene] I am Mira. The canyon is wide, and grief is heavy. I will carry both.
audition.cousin: [shrieking with joy] Pip! PIP! Shelly woke up! [giggling] Last one in is a sea slug!
audition.lumen: [theatrical, grand] Lumen’s the name, light’s the game! [stage whisper] Shh. Sleeping piranhas. Tippy-tippy-toe.
audition.murk: [deep, whispering, broken] Please… don’t be afraid. [resolute] I won’t be afraid again.
audition.grimtide: [silky, amused] Thank you for the map, little light. [menacing whisper] I’ll be waiting at every gate. [laughs darkly]
audition.snip: [sneering] Well, well. A little light! [cackling] Ooh, flat as a flounder!
audition.snap: [snarling] Boss says nobody leaves the Shallows! [snarling laugh] Thanks for the snack!
audition.keeper: [gentle, like a memory] If you’re hearing this, someone found my first coin. Hello, little diver.

lines.text: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls.
lines.when: Intro film: the reef at night

lines.text: [a little worried] One night, a huge storm hits the reef…
…and sweeps all the pearls away. [whispers] The reef goes dark.
lines.when: Intro film: the lights blow away

lines.text: [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
lines.when: Intro film: the helmet lamp clicks on

lines.text: Swim into the sand to dig a tunnel.
The tunnel reaches the gate. Now get behind the red pearl…
lines.when: Intro film: diver above the gate

lines.text: [excited] …and push it to the gate!
[amazed] The gate wakes up, and the light comes back!
Twenty-nine gates are still dark. [warmly] Can you wake them all?
This is you. Swim, dig and push your way to the gate.
This red pearl is full of light. The gate needs it.
Push the pearl in to wake the gate, then swim in yourself.
Air starts on your first move, so look around first. Finish before it runs out!
Swipe to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Use the arrow keys to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Take the sand away under a stone, and it falls.
[gently] Never stand right under a stone!
Falling stones and pearls roll off round things, and they roll left first.
[a little worried] It patrols the water, and charges the moment it sees you.
[playfully] Drop a stone on it to stop it for good.
It drifts up and down its shaft. Cross when it is far away.
It scuttles back and forth. Stay out of its path!
[brightly] Swim into it for forty-five more seconds of air.
[warmly] Deeper now. Welcome to the Coral Caves. [softly] Plan before you dig.
[hushed] This is The Deep. Only the bravest divers come this far.
[cheerfully] Today's dive is the same for every diver. Ready? Go!
[amazed] Every gate is awake. The whole reef is glowing again!
[warmly] Thank you, little diver. The Glow Reef shines because of you.
[excited] Woohoo! The light's back!
Gate's awake. Onward!
[giggles] Easy as bubbles!
[sighs] Oof… let's try that again.
[determined] Hold on, I've got this!
[happy] Got one!
One more!
[giggles] In you go!
[excited] It's open!
Yes! Let's go!
[gasps] Ooh, treasure!
[giggles] Bonk!
[excited] Double!
[relieved] Phew!
That was close!
[nervous] I need air!
Whoops!
[playfully] Wait, wait… one more time!
[warm] Your air runs down as you dive. Swim up to the top of the tank to breathe again.
[gently urgent] Low on air! Swim up to the top of the tank to breathe.
lines.when: First time the air runs low in a level

lines.text: [gasping, relieved] Ahh! Fresh air!
lines.when: The diver breathes at the surface (sometimes)

lines.text: [warm, wonder] Once, the reef glowed every night. And the brightest light of all was the Great Lantern.
lines.when: Prologue · The Night the Lights Went Out

lines.text: [excited, showing off] Ooh! Ooh! Look at me! I'm the second brightest thing here!
lines.when: Prologue · The Night the Lights Went Out

lines.text: [silky, hungry] Such pretty little lights. I'll take them. ALL of them.
lines.when: Prologue · The Night the Lights Went Out

lines.text: [tense, building] Grimtide, the eel who drinks light, rose out of the abyss, and the reef's lights poured into his jaws.
lines.when: Prologue · The Night the Lights Went Out

lines.text: [fierce, heroic] Not while I'm Keeper!
lines.when: Prologue · The Night the Lights Went Out

lines.text: [hushed, sad] The Reef Keeper gave all her light to save the Lantern. Grimtide fled… and the whole reef went dark.
lines.when: Prologue · The Night the Lights Went Out

lines.text: [tiny, scared, alone] Hello…? Anybody…?
lines.when: Prologue · The Night the Lights Went Out

lines.text: [excited, rapid] AAAH! A light! Are you a light? A fish? A light-fish?
[giggling] I'm Pip! And you're Spark now. No take-backs.
[hushed, ominous] Far away, in the dark, something very big opens one red eye.
[excited, nervous] Ooh. Cool. Can I come? I'm very brave. Mostly in my head.
lines.when: Chapter 1 · Through the Old Pipe — choice “Who are you?”: brave answer “I'm here to turn the lights back on.”

lines.text: [laughing] Ha! A funny one! The reef has been SO not funny lately.
lines.when: Chapter 1 · Through the Old Pipe — choice “Who are you?”: funny answer “A lost tourist. Gift shop?”

lines.text: [touched, soft] Nobody's asked me that since the storm. I'm… better now.
lines.when: Chapter 1 · Through the Old Pipe — choice “Who are you?”: kind answer “A friend. You okay?”

lines.text: [proud] Real talk, Spark. I used to GLOW. Pip the Bright!
[flustered, then scared] Then the storm came. It had red EYES. It ate every light in the reef.
[excited] But your gate made me sparkle! A teeny bit! Do it again!
[overjoyed] I'm GLOWING! A teeny bit! Okay, a medium bit!
lines.when: Chapter 2 · Pip’s Glow — after “Catch the sparkles!” (done in time)

lines.text: [brave, cheerful] Still sparkly! Teeny, but sparkly!
lines.when: Chapter 2 · Pip’s Glow — after “Catch the sparkles!” (missed)

lines.text: [deadpan] Grimtide. An eel as long as a shipwreck. He drinks light.
[horrified] Drinks it? Like a smoothie?
[deadpan, urgent] Like a smoothie. And now he knows about you. Hop on!
[trembling, pretending] I'm not scared. My fins are just cold.
[dry, secretly pleased] Hmph. Not bad, for a light-fish.
lines.when: Chapter 3 · Shelly’s Tale — after “Ride on Shelly! Dodge the rocks!” (done in time)

lines.text: [dry, unbothered] Bumpy. My shell has had worse.
lines.when: Chapter 3 · Shelly’s Tale — after “Ride on Shelly! Dodge the rocks!” (missed)

lines.text: [booming, pompous] HALT! Crack Crab Crew! Name, rank, and favourite snack!
[grand] Pip, you're promoted! Deputy Assistant Vice Captain!
[deadpan] I've been here five seconds.
[proud] And already a natural!
[delighted] HA! A diver with priorities! I like you already!
lines.when: Chapter 4 · Captain Clack — choice “Name, rank, snack?”: brave answer “Spark. Snacks later, heroics now.”

lines.text: [delighted] Seaweed chips! A diver of TASTE! Crew, this one is one of us!
lines.when: Chapter 4 · Captain Clack — choice “Name, rank, snack?”: funny answer “Spark. Seaweed chips.”

lines.text: [flustered, proud] Famous? Me? Well. Yes. Obviously. Crew, did you HEAR that?
lines.when: Chapter 4 · Captain Clack — choice “Name, rank, snack?”: kind answer “The famous captain, I presume?”

lines.text: [excited] A bouncy staircase! Jump, Spark! Jump!
[pompous, then delighted] A captain does NOT bounce. A captain ascends. WHEEEE!
[flustered, proud] Dignified. Extremely dignified. Nobody saw me squeal.
lines.when: Chapter 5 · Jelly Bounce — after “Bounce on the beat!” (done in time)

lines.text: [wincing, giggly] Ow, stingy! Are jellies supposed to be stingy?
lines.when: Chapter 5 · Jelly Bounce — after “Bounce on the beat!” (missed)

lines.text: [excited, nervous] Open it! No, what if it bites? …Open it!
[gentle, like a memory] “Wake the gates. Shared light is the one thing he cannot drink.”
[proud] A map! Hand it here. Captains are excellent with maps.
[deadpan] You're holding it upside down.
[booming, proud] Exactly as I planned! The map is safe!
lines.when: Chapter 6 · The Keeper’s Map — after “Turn the crank on the beat!” (done in time)

lines.text: [breathless] We made it! Mostly! The map is a bit soggy.
lines.when: Chapter 6 · The Keeper’s Map — after “Turn the crank on the beat!” (missed)

lines.text: [nervous] Spark… gates don't usually wink.
[silky, amused] Thank you, little light. A map with every gate marked.
[menacing whisper] Keep waking them. I'll be waiting at every one.
[crying softly] Spark… my glow is going out.
[straining, through gritted teeth] Not! Letting! GO!
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (done in time)

lines.text: [tense] The map tears in two. A torn corner drifts off into the dark.
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (done in time)

lines.text: [desperate] No! The map!
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (missed)

lines.text: [tense] He rips it free. A torn corner drifts off into the dark.
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (missed)

lines.text: [sniffling] This is my fault. I said “ooh, pretty light”. I literally said “ooh”.
[triumphant] FISH! Exactly as I planned.
[laughing through tears] Who needs his map anyway?
[brave, sniffly] Ourselves. Okay! I am GREAT at ourselves.
lines.when: Chapter 8 · Follow the Fish — choice “Cheer Pip up”: brave answer “We'll find the gates ourselves.”

lines.text: [laughing through tears] It was SO pretty. Okay. I feel a little better.
lines.when: Chapter 8 · Follow the Fish — choice “Cheer Pip up”: funny answer “It WAS a very pretty light.”

lines.text: [soft, grateful] …Together. Okay. Together.
lines.when: Chapter 8 · Follow the Fish — choice “Cheer Pip up”: kind answer “You warned me. We're a team.”

lines.text: [excited] Look! The torn piece of the map!
[thoughtful] One gate. On the edge of a cliff.
[grumbling] Cliffs. Crabs and cliffs have a long and painful history.
[cheeky, giddy] Ha! Ink can’t catch us!
lines.when: Chapter 9 · The Torn Map — after “Outrun the ink cloud!” (done in time)

lines.text: [grumbling] I have ink in places a crab should never have ink.
lines.when: Chapter 9 · The Torn Map — after “Outrun the ink cloud!” (missed)

lines.text: [sneering, cackling] Ooh, Snap! Little light wants the STAIRS!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [snarling] There are no stairs. Only US.
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [yelling, fading away] Crabs… don’t… fall… WELLLLL!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [dizzy, furious] This isn't over, little light! …Snap, which way is up?
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows — after “Escape Snip & Snap!” (done in time)

lines.text: [snarling, fading] Next time, little light. NEXT TIME.
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows — after “Escape Snip & Snap!” (missed)

lines.text: [echoing, amused] Welcome to my caves, little light. Mind the echo. It’s ME.
[panicking] He can SEE us!
[echoing whisper] Every crystal you light shows me where you are.
[amused, menacing] …Bold. I like bold. Bold tastes better.
lines.when: Chapter 11 · Voices in the Caves — choice “Answer Grimtide”: brave answer “Then we'll light them ALL.”

lines.text: [offended, flustered] I… That is… how RUDE.
lines.when: Chapter 11 · Voices in the Caves — choice “Answer Grimtide”: funny answer “Do you always talk this much?”

lines.text: [small, brave] It's working. But… okay. Closer.
lines.when: Chapter 11 · Voices in the Caves — choice “Answer Grimtide”: kind answer “Stay close, Pip.”

lines.text: [singing softly] “Share your light, and the light comes home…”
[sad] But the last clam stays shut. Grimtide stole its song.
[warm but worried] Remember that tune, little ones.
[singing, joyful] “…and the light comes home!”
lines.when: Chapter 12 · The Silent Clam — after “Sing the Keeper’s song!” (done in time)

lines.text: [warm, wonder] The last clam opens. Its song comes back, and so does its pearl.
lines.when: Chapter 12 · The Silent Clam — after “Sing the Keeper’s song!” (done in time)

lines.text: [gentle, hopeful] The last clam stays shut… but deep inside, something hums along.
lines.when: Chapter 12 · The Silent Clam — after “Sing the Keeper’s song!” (missed)

lines.text: [roaring] Thirteen gates, little light? Thirteen too many!
[shouting, commanding] Everyone behind my shell! NOW!
[slow, heartbroken] Shelly takes the whole blow… and sinks to the sand.
[cold, quiet] One down.
[panicking] I'm holding! I'm holding! Where's Shelly?!
lines.when: Chapter 13 · The Dark Storm — after “Get everyone through the storm!” (done in time)

lines.text: [screaming] Spark! I can't hold on!
lines.when: Chapter 13 · The Dark Storm — after “Get everyone through the storm!” (missed)

lines.text: [crying] Shelly? Shelly, please wake up…
[weak, earnest] I can't swim on. Promise me you'll wake every gate.
[gruff, emotional] Go. Nobody touches this turtle while Clack has claws.
[weak, proud] I’ll hold you to that.
lines.when: Chapter 14 · Rest, Old Friend — choice “Promise Shelly”: brave answer “I promise. Then I'm coming back.”

lines.text: [weak laugh] Deal. It’s a long one. Two hundred years.
lines.when: Chapter 14 · Rest, Old Friend — choice “Promise Shelly”: funny answer “Promise. You owe me a story.”

lines.text: [weak, tender] I know you do. That’s why I can rest.
lines.when: Chapter 14 · Rest, Old Friend — choice “Promise Shelly”: kind answer “Rest, Shelly. We've got this.”

lines.text: [serene] I am Mira. An old turtle sent me a message.
[serene, amused] “Tell them I’m proud. And tell the crab to stop fussing.”
[laughing, teary] That's definitely Shelly.
[giddy, then soft] WHEEEE! Again! AGAIN! Shelly would have LOVED that!
lines.when: Chapter 15 · Mira — after “Ride the canyon with Mira!” (done in time)

lines.text: [queasy] I think I swallowed a jellyfish. Is that bad? It feels bad.
lines.when: Chapter 15 · Mira — after “Ride the canyon with Mira!” (missed)

lines.text: [terrified whisper] Spark… EYES in there. Bigger than Shelly!
[deep, apologetic] Please don't scream. I'm Murk. Sorry about my face.
[startled whisper] Wait… that lamp. Where did you get that lamp?
[whispered, worried] He's gone… but he saw your lamp, Spark.
lines.when: Chapter 16 · The Prisoner — after “Hide from the searchlight!” (done in time)

lines.text: [sad, whispered] Too dark… we lost him.
lines.when: Chapter 16 · The Prisoner — after “Hide from the searchlight!” (missed)

lines.text: [ancient, echoing] “Grimtide fears one thing: light that is given away.”
[puzzled] But he TAKES light. He’s a big… taking… noodle.
[realizing, excited] That's how we beat him, Pip.
[excited] You did it! The arch remembers!
lines.when: Chapter 17 · The Arch’s Secret — after “Light the lamps!” (done in time)

lines.text: [gentle] One by one, the old lamps flicker awake on their own.
lines.when: Chapter 17 · The Arch’s Secret — after “Light the lamps!” (missed)

lines.text: [excited] Murk left them! He’s a spy! A big squishy spy!
[suspicious, cold, distant] Murk… why are my pearls floating away?
[nervous, far away] …Currents?
[thrilled] We got them all! Well, most! Murk, you big squishy hero!

lines.text: [determined] Some floated away… but we know the way now!
lines.when: Chapter 18 · A Secret Trail — after “Catch Murk's floating pearls!” (missed)

lines.text: [shrieking with joy] PIP! Shelly woke up! She’s okay!
[overjoyed] SHE'S OKAY! Spark! She's okay!
[giggling] And the loud crab says: “Don’t save the reef without me!”
[excited] Ooh, intense! I’ll tell him!
lines.when: Chapter 19 · Good News — choice “Message for home”: brave answer “Tell him to hurry up!”

lines.text: [cackling] Ha! He’s going to HATE that!
lines.when: Chapter 19 · Good News — choice “Message for home”: funny answer “We’ll save him a bit of reef.”

lines.text: [sweet] She knows. She says it first, every morning.
lines.when: Chapter 19 · Good News — choice “Message for home”: kind answer “Tell Shelly we love her.”

lines.text: [ominous] Wrapped around the Great Lantern like a storm cloud: Grimtide.
[delighted, menacing] Twenty gates! You’re not saving the reef. You’re setting my table.
[frightened] Why does he keep talking about FOOD?
[giddy, then nervous] He didn't even see us! …Did he?

lines.text: [silky, menacing] Run along, little light. I can wait.
lines.when: Chapter 20 · The Lantern in Chains — after “Hide from Grimtide's eye!” (missed)

lines.text: [theatrical, grand] Lumen’s the name, light’s the game!
[dropping the act] I’ve been hiding for three weeks. In a sock. Don’t ask.
[brave, theatrical] Going after him? Then my light is yours. Showtime!
[theatrical, delighted] Standing ovation! You two are naturals!
lines.when: Chapter 21 · Lumen — after “Hit Lumen's beat!” (done in time)

lines.text: [theatrical, warm] Little stage fright. Happens to the best of us!
[booming] Did somebody say CAPTAIN?
[overjoyed] CLACK!
[proud, chuckling] Shelly sends her love. And a VERY rude message for Grimtide.
[giddy, then gruff] WHEEE! I mean… dignified whee.
lines.when: Chapter 22 · Whale Song — after “Swim with Bellow’s song!” (done in time)

lines.text: [cheerful] Bumpy song! Still pretty!
lines.when: Chapter 22 · Whale Song — after “Swim with Bellow’s song!” (missed)

lines.text: [stunned whisper] Spark… look at her helmet. Her LAMP.
[shaken, quiet] It's my lamp.
[soft, amazed] Kid, in show business we call that a plot twist.
[theatrical, triumphant] And THAT is how you exit a scene!
lines.when: Chapter 23 · The Mural — after “The ruins are falling! Swim!” (done in time)

lines.text: [theatrical, shaken] A bit of rubble. The show goes on!
lines.when: Chapter 23 · The Mural — after “The ruins are falling! Swim!” (missed)

lines.text: [joyful] Twenty-four gates! We’re actually going to—
[roaring] ENOUGH!
[roaring, charging] Let him go, you overgrown NOODLE!
[cold, triumphant] Come to my lair, little light. Or never see your seahorse again.
[desperate] I've got you! I've got… NO!
lines.when: Chapter 24 · Ambush — after “Chase Grimtide! Save Pip!” (done in time)

lines.text: [cold, amused] Too slow, little light. Much too slow.
lines.when: Chapter 24 · Ambush — after “Chase Grimtide! Save Pip!” (missed)

lines.text: [weak, rasping] Did I get him? Tell me I pinched him good.
[weak, fading] Tell my crew… finest crew… on the whole reef.
[grieving, then fierce] You brave, loud, wonderful fool. Up, little one. Grimtide has Pip.
[weak, smiling] Magnificent… put that on my shell.
lines.when: Chapter 25 · The Captain’s Last Order — choice “Answer the Captain”: brave answer “You were magnificent, Captain.”

lines.text: [weak laugh] Ha… good. Good.
lines.when: Chapter 25 · The Captain’s Last Order — choice “Answer the Captain”: funny answer “He'll walk funny for a week.”

lines.text: [weak, at peace] Then it was worth it.
lines.when: Chapter 25 · The Captain’s Last Order — choice “Answer the Captain”: kind answer “You saved us, Captain.”

lines.text: [crying, joyful] Spark! You came! I said “Spark will come” like four hundred times!
[gentle] Murk. This was her lamp, wasn’t it?
[breaking] …She was my best friend.
[joyful roar] FREE! Group hug! I have eight arms, everyone's included!
[soaring] You hold up a glowing pearl and give it away. The ink chains melt.
lines.when: Chapter 26 · Breaking the Chains — after “Give your light!” (done in time)

lines.text: [soaring] The pearl’s light pours out on its own, and the ink chains melt.
lines.when: Chapter 26 · Breaking the Chains — after “Give your light!” (missed)

lines.text: [quiet, ashamed] The night of the storm, she faced him alone. I was too scared to follow.
[brave, shaky] I'm not scared. My fins are just… okay, I'm scared. Going anyway!
[deep, resolute] Together.
lines.when: Chapter 27 · Over the Abyss — choice “Answer Murk”: brave answer “This time, we go together.”

lines.text: [deep laugh] Eight arms of fury. I like that.
lines.when: Chapter 27 · Over the Abyss — choice “Answer Murk”: funny answer “Eight arms. Use them ALL.”

lines.text: [deep, moved] …She would have said that. Thank you.
lines.when: Chapter 27 · Over the Abyss — choice “Answer Murk”: kind answer “It wasn't your fault, Murk.”

[ecstatic, theatrical] Standing ovation! The whole Deep is GLOWING!

lines.text: [brave, theatrical] A few lights short, but the show goes on, darling!

lines.text: [greedy, ecstatic] YES! Give it to me!
[screaming] No… NO! It BURNS! Too SHARED!
[triumphant, amused] And mighty Grimtide shrinks… to a tiny, very grumpy worm.
[nervous] Uh… Snap? I think we work for a worm now.
[muffled, then booming] Did somebody say… CAPTAIN?
[shrieking with joy] CLACK?! You were brave the whole way, Spark. Everybody was!

lines.text: [warm, soaring] The Heart Pearl rises home. And the whole reef shines.
[shouting] It was never yours!

lines.text: [shouting] Everybody, NOW! Give it away!

lines.text: [gently] Dig into the sand. Push the red pearl into the gate.
[excited] The gate is awake! Swim in!
[urgent, cheeky] Psst, Spark! Stones fall if you dig under them. Don’t be under them!
[giggling] Ooh, I felt that! My glow tickles!
[overjoyed] Two gates! Look, look, I’m sparkling!
[nervous, fast] A giant eel who drinks light… Nope. Not thinking about it. Digging!
[scared whisper] Did… did something just blink out there?
[warm, dry] Well done, little one. Now swim in, before my old bones get cold.
[booming] Crew! Escort the gate-waker! Eyes sharp, claws sharper!
[proud] A fine push! I taught you that. I didn’t. But I would have.
[cheeky] Four gates! Take that, Grimtide!
[sneering] Well, well. A little light. Snap, look! A snack!
[fierce] Don’t listen to them, Spark! Drop a stone on them!
[triumphant] HA! Five gates! Hear that? The jellies are singing!
[focused] Jellyfish float up and down. Wait for the gap… then go!
[wise, pompous] Patience, gate-waker. A good captain waits for the tide.
[excited] Six! The wreck is right there!
[careful] The map says this gate has a keystone. Careful where you dig.
[dreamy] Spark… do you see that glow over there? It’s so pretty…
[silky whisper] Yes, little light. Come and see the pretty glow…
[sniffling] My glow is so faint… Stay close to me, okay?
[blustering] No map, no problem! I have an excellent sense of direction. Mostly.
[amazed] We found it without the map! We actually did it!
[whispering] Ink everywhere… He came this way.
[distant, amused] I can smell your little lamp from here.
[excited] Nine! The torn map piece is close. I can feel it!
[snarling] Last gate of the Shallows, little light. Shame you won’t reach it.
[cackling] Boss says hurry it up, Snap! Shake the vault!
[scared, brave] Ten gates. Hold my fin, Spark. Here comes the cliff…
[echoing whisper] Little light… turn back.
[defiant] Every crystal we light, he sees us. So let’s light them ALL.
[cheeky] Eleven! Ha! He can echo all he likes!
[calm, slow] Breathe slow, little one. Air is precious this deep.
[soft] That pearl is for the silent clam. I just know it.
[uneasy] Twelve. Why does the water feel so heavy?
[scared] Something’s wrong. The water’s going dark…
[menacing, close] I’m coming for you, little light.
[urgent] Swim in, quickly! Something huge is coming!
[quiet, sad] Shelly would want us to keep going. So we keep going.
[distant, shouting] She’s sleeping sound, gate-waker! I’ve got her!
[soft, tearful] Fourteen. Rest well, Shelly.
[determined] For Shelly. Let’s go!
[serene] Steady, little one. Every gate you wake reaches her too.
[happy, tearful] Fifteen gates! She’d be so proud of us.
[worried] That poor octopus… and why did he ask about your lamp?
[roaring, distant] Murk! Back to work!
[determined] Sixteen. Whatever it takes, Spark. We free him.
[thinking aloud] Light that’s given away… How do you give light away?
[realizing, excited] Wait. Every pearl we give the gate… is light, given away!
[excited] Seventeen! Look, pearls rising from the sand!
[faint whisper] This way… the pearls will guide you…
[suspicious, cold] Murk… who are you whispering to?
[curious, excited] Eighteen! Someone’s coming… my cousins?
[giggling] Race you to the gate, Pip! Last one in is a sea slug!
[joyful] Shelly’s okay! I can’t stop smiling!
[laughing] Nooo, you won! Okay, rematch at the Lantern!
[uneasy] He’s wrapped around the Lantern… What did he mean, “setting the table”?
[hungry whisper] Hurry, little light. I’m hungry.
[brave] Twenty. The Deep is next. Stay close.
[stage whisper] Shh! Sleeping piranhas. Tiptoe, my friends. Tippy-tippy-toe.
[groggy, sniffing] Huh? Snap… do you smell lamp?
[theatrical] Twenty-one! Bravo! Bravissimo!
[booming] Captain on deck! Now, where’s this gate I keep hearing about?
[thrilled] Listen! Old Bellow sings louder with every pearl!
[triumphant] Twenty-two! Grimtide’s getting weaker, crew!
[serious] The pressure’s strong down here. Watch your air, Keeper.
[awed] Your lamp, Spark… it’s really hers. That’s amazing. And kind of scary.
[determined] Twenty-three. Murk, we’re coming!
[cold whisper] I see you, little light.
[uneasy] Stay close, Spark. Something feels wrong today.
[joyful, then scared] Twenty-four! Look how bright it is! Wait… what’s that shadow?
[fierce, grieving] For Clack. For Pip. Wake this gate.
[cruel, amused] Your little seahorse is crying for you. How sweet.
[fierce] Hold on, Pip. We’re coming!
[tense] Murk’s den is close. I can hear Pip.
[faint, echoing, crying] Spark? Is that you? Hurry!
[fierce] Twenty-six. Now, to Pip!
[brave] Thank you for coming for me. Now let’s finish this!
[deep, calm] The undertow pulls hard here. Trust it, and you’ll find the way.
[resolute] Twenty-seven. His lair is near.
[thrilled] Look behind you! The whole Deep is glowing!
[mocking] Shine, little lights. Shine for my feast.
[triumphant] Twenty-eight! Everyone is with us!
[menacing] Turn back, Keeper’s child. Or lose everything.
[deep, urgent] He’s afraid. I can feel it. Keep going!
[resolute] One gate left. Let’s end this.
[nervous, brave] This is it. The last gate. Ready, Spark?
[nervous] Uh… Snap? I think we picked the wrong side.
[greedy, roaring] Faster, little light! Give me my Heart!
[shouting] Now! Swim in, and give the light away!
[panicked] Spark! No, no, no… Undo it! Please!
[cackling] Ooh! Flat as a flounder!
[shouting] Man down! MAN DOWN!
[amused] Careful, little light. The reef is so very heavy.
[snarling laugh] Grimtide says thanks for the snack!
[cackling] Crunchy! Ha!
[screaming] Spark! Get away from it!
[silky] My pets were hungry.
[panicked] Spark, your air! Hold on!
[worried] Too deep, too long. Come back up, child.
[mocking] Breathe, little light. Oh… you can’t.
[gentle, like an old memory] If you’re hearing this, someone found my first coin. Hello, little diver.
[gentle, like an old memory] I hid thirty coins across the reef. Each one remembers something.
[gentle, like an old memory] I was afraid of the dark once, too. So I made a lamp.
[gentle, like an old memory] Clack’s grandmother was a captain too. Twice as loud.
[gentle, like an old memory] The jellies taught me to sing. Terrible teachers. Wonderful singers.
[gentle, like an old memory] I left a map in an old wreck. Just in case.
[gentle, like an old memory] Never follow a light that flickers. Real light holds steady.
[gentle, like an old memory] When I felt lost, I followed the fish. They always know the way home.
[gentle, like an old memory] Every map tears, sooner or later. Your heart is the better map.
[gentle, like an old memory] Jumping is easy. It’s the deciding that’s hard.
[gentle, like an old memory] The caves echo your fear back at you. So I sang to them instead.
[gentle, like an old memory] The clams sang to me the night I built the first gate.
[gentle, like an old memory] Grimtide’s storms are loud. But they never last.
[gentle, like an old memory] Old Shelly carried me when I was small. She’ll carry you too.
[gentle, like an old memory] Grief is heavy. Share it, and it gets lighter. Just like light.
[gentle, like an old memory] I met a little octopus who was scared of everything. His name was Murk.
[gentle, like an old memory] Murk and I learned the secret together: light given away comes back brighter.
[gentle, like an old memory] Murk always left me pearls to find. A trail, so I’d never get lost.
[gentle, like an old memory] Good news travels fastest in a school of fish.
[gentle, like an old memory] I built the Lantern to hold the reef’s light. I never thought he’d come for it.
[gentle, like an old memory] The Deep is dark, but it’s never empty. Someone is always shining.
[gentle, like an old memory] Old Bellow sang the day the Lantern was lit. Listen for him.
[gentle, like an old memory] They painted me on a wall once. I looked much taller.
[gentle, like an old memory] If he takes someone you love, don’t give up. That’s what he wants.
[gentle, like an old memory] Brave isn’t not being scared. Brave is going anyway.
[gentle, like an old memory] If you find Murk, tell him it wasn’t his fault. It never was.
[gentle, like an old memory] The trench is deep, but friends make good bridges.
[gentle, like an old memory] One light alone is easy to drink. A thousand lights are not.
[gentle, like an old memory] The night of the storm, I gave all my light to the Lantern. It was worth it.
[gentle, like an old memory] Whoever wears my lamp now: thank you. The reef is yours to keep shining.
